# Insta360 App：3D 时光舱

## Insta360 App：3D 时光舱

**适用产品：**X4 Air，X5，X6


##### 3D 时光舱可将您拍摄的全景视频转化为可自由探索的 3D 空间，足不出户即可重温旅行与生活中的精彩场景，带来沉浸式的空间漫游体验。下面为您介绍 3D 时光舱的使用方法，并解答常见问题。
---


#### 功能说明

在开始使用前，您可以先了解以下 3D 时光舱功能的基础信息，确保设备与素材符合要求。

|  **功能支持**  |  **具体说明**  |
|---|---|
|  Insta360 App 与系统要求  |  Insta360 App 需升级至 v2.31.1 及以上版本 iOS 系统需 16.4 及以上 / Android 系统需 14 及以上  |
|  功能入口  |  3D 时光舱功能目前支持 X6、X5、X4 Air 机型，连接其中任一机型，Insta360 App 内会自动显示该功能入口。  |
|  素材类型  |  **支持素材：**仅支持全景普通视频模式拍摄的素材，单段最长支持 2 分钟素材用于生成（超时素材在生成时会提示需要截取）。 **不支持素材：**行车记录、慢动作、移动延时等特殊视频模式，照片素材，以及杜比视界、I\-Log、机内直出滤镜等改变画面默认色彩的模式。  |
|  功能场景  |  **推荐场景：**日常、Vlog、旅行等拍摄主体以正常速度移动的场景。 **不适合场景：**剧烈运动、骑行、汽车等场景，以及画面出现大量人物或移动物体、光线不足的场景。  |


#### 如何拍摄 3D 时光舱素材

您可以参考以下拍摄建议获得更好的重建效果：

|  **拍摄类别**  |  **拍摄建议**  |
|---|---|
|  拍摄场景与对象  |  
- 选择一个相对完整、范围明确的空间进行拍摄，例如室外的有限区域，或室内光线充足的空间（推荐）。 
- 避免只围绕单个人物或单一固定物体进行拍摄。 
- 建议您以 S 型路线行走，从多个视角覆盖希望重建的场景。 
- 建议拍摄面积不超过 100 平方米。 
- 建议您保持匀速行走，速度不超过每秒 1 米，尽量避免奔跑，以获得更稳定的素材。  |
|  相机档位与模式  |  推荐您使用 8K@30fps 全景视频录像模式。 ***温馨提示：****3D 时光舱支持 5.7K/6K/8K 分辨率，支持 30/50/60 帧率，但视频规格越高，生成时长相应越长。*  |
|  拍摄时长  |  建议控制在 2 分钟内  |
|  相机持握方式  |  当举过头顶拍摄时：请确保相机高于头顶约 20 厘米。 当举在胸前拍摄时：请确保相机距离身体大于 0.5 米。 ***温馨提示：****您可参考 *[*相机持握方式以及拍摄路线视频教程*](https://wassets.insta360.com/common/4fe4e2b44c574737bcabf3f3a6f57161/%E6%8B%8D%E6%91%84%E8%AF%B4%E6%98%8E.mp4)*。*  |
|  拍摄路线  |  
- 将相机举过头顶或举在胸前，在拍摄空间中进行 “折返” 行走，确保 “折返” 行走的路径覆盖整个可通行区域。 
- 折返路径的间距建议小于 2 米。 
- 拍摄时的行走速度尽量缓慢均匀，最佳拍摄速度约为日常行走速度慢 30%。 
- 若拍摄的空间中有希望呈现更多细节的目标对象，可在折返路径覆盖全部区域后，针对感兴趣的目标进行环绕式拍摄。 
- 拍摄场景中出现行人无需担心，算法会自动进行行人去除以保证空间重建质量。  |

#### 常见问题

##### 生成次数与钻石兑换相关
1. **每月有几次 3D 时光舱免费生成机会？是否支持额外付费购买生成机会？**

每个账号每月 1 日将发放 4 次免费生成额度。若您将 Insta360 App 升级至 v2.32.0 及以上版本，将支持使用钻石兑换 3D 时光舱生成次数；钻石不足时，您可付费购买钻石。

1. **使用 3D 时光舱时，免费次数和钻石的消耗优先级是怎样的？**

3D 时光舱会优先消耗免费次数。当账号存在可用免费次数时，不会扣减钻石；当免费次数全部用完后，才会自动消耗钻石进行生成。

1. **当月未用完的 3D 时光舱生成次数能否累积到下个月？**

不能。当月未使用的次数不累计至下个月，每月发放次数按自然月 1 号重置。

1. **3D 时光舱生成失败的次数会返还吗？**

若因网络异常、服务器报错等非用户原因导致生成失败，生成次数将在判定失败后退回账户。

1. **3D 时光舱生成过程中不慎手动取消，对应的生成次数可以返还吗？**

生成过程中若您主动取消 3D 时光舱生成（如退出页面、关闭界面、手动停止任务），系统将记为一次已使用额度，生成次数暂不支持返还，感谢您的理解与支持。

1. **使用钻石生成一次 3D 时光舱，需要消耗多少钻石？**

单次 3D 时光舱生成需消耗 50 钻石。


##### 设备性能与体验相关
1. **为什么页面提示 “检测到当前设备性能不足，可能导致处理时长大幅增加或崩溃” ？**

性能较低的设备在生成过程中可能出现卡顿、应用闪退等情况。为保障您的使用体验，系统会在生成前自动弹出风险提示。建议您收到提示后关闭后台闲置应用，确保设备电量和存储空间充足，再重新尝试生成。

1. **使用 3D 时光舱时手机发烫明显，正常吗？**

高性能机型预览时渲染速度快、算力调用高，因此手机发热会较为明显。建议您避免边充电边生成。


##### 生成效果相关
1. **3D 时光舱水印中的 “Remy” 指的是什么？为什么生成的 3D 时光舱画面下方出现 “由 Insta360 拍摄 Remy 生成” 水印？能否去除？**

Remy 与 3D 时光舱空间影像体验技术相关，Remy 水印用于标识此内容是通过该功能创建的，会显示在通过 3D 时光舱空间影像功能创建的内容中，暂不支持去除此水印。同时该功能正在通过分阶段方式逐步开放，不同地区的支持范围可能有所不同。我们会持续优化体验，并推进更多地区的支持。

1. **使用 3D 时光涟漪 / 粒子特效生成的平面视频可以自行编辑吗？导出水印可以去掉吗？**

暂不支持自定义编辑视频内容，也无法移除导出水印。

1. **为什么 3D 时光舱的特效视频加载很慢 / 播放等待时间很长？**

3D 时光舱特效视频受限于网络传输和移动端解码性能，播放等待时间较长。建议您在 Wi\-Fi 环境下使用。

1. **在 3D 时光舱空间里移动时为什么会出现 “穿模” 再回弹？**

3D 时光舱空间移动的交互效果正在持续优化中。未来我们将持续优化产品，为您提供更好的使用体验，感谢您的理解与支持！

1. **3D 时光舱的人物消除效果不够理想（如人物消一半），怎么办？**

目前人物消除功能正在持续优化中，未来我们将持续优化产品，为您提供更好的使用体验，感谢您的理解与支持！

1. **3D 时光舱生成封面的人物角度不好看，能否手动选择封面？**

封面选取功能正在持续优化中，未来我们将为您提供更好的使用体验，感谢您的理解与支持！

1. **3D 时光舱是否支持高度方向移动查看（如爬山或上楼梯场景中的向上 / 向下移动）？**

目前 3D 时光舱暂不支持高度方向移动查看，仅支持平面移动。未来我们将持续优化产品，为您提供更好的使用体验，感谢您的理解与支持！


##### 生成作品使用相关
1. **生成的 3D 时光舱作品在另一个 Insta360 App 账号可以查看吗？**

3D 时光舱生成的作品与您的 Insta360 App 账号绑定，跨设备登录同一账号即可查看对应内容。暂不支持分享给其他 Insta360 App 账号或离线导出。

1. **3D 时光舱生成的作品支持 VR 眼镜查看吗？**

暂不支持 VR 眼镜查看。

1. **可以下载 3D 时光舱生成的源文件吗？**

暂不支持源文件下载功能。

1. **3D 时光舱生成后可以再编辑吗？**

暂不支持对生成结果进行编辑，如需调整需重新创建空间。

The content creation landscape is undergoing a profound transformation. 3D Gaussian Splatting \(3DGS\) has emerged as a breakthrough technique for real\-time, photorealistic 3D scene reconstruction from 2D images or video. Unlike traditional photogrammetry or slower neural radiance fields \(NeRF\), 3DGS delivers high\-fidelity results with efficient rendering, making it ideal for web\-based viewing, VR/AR experiences, digital twins, and even AI training environments.

To explore the boundaries of this technology, Insta360 and Antigravity launched **Project Eternal**, a global initiative that invited creators to capture real\-world spaces using [Insta360 X5](https://store.insta360.com/product/x5?utm_term=INRRF09&i_source=website&i_medium=blog&i_campaign=article18925) and [Antigravity A1](https://www.antigravity.tech/us/drone/antigravity-a1/buy?utm_term=INRRF09&i_source=website&i_medium=blog&i_campaign=article18925) and transform them into explorable 3D worlds. At the same time, we launched the \#Turn360to3D challenge to engage the broader creator community.

Insta360 Enterprise partnered with three leading providers of 3DGS solutions for this campaign — **[Splatica](https://app.splatica.com/), [Aholo](https://www.aholo3d.com/), and [MipMap](https://na.mipmap3d.com/)** — to capture and process over 30 global landmarks into high\-fidelity, web\-explorable 3D models. The result demonstrated something important: the path from physical reality to the digital world is no longer reserved for specialized engineers. It is now accessible to everyone.

## Why Insta360 Enterprise Joined Project Eternal

At Insta360, we focus on the foundational role that high\-quality capture plays in 3DGS workflows. Premium 360\-degree capture simplifies the collection of rich visual data from real spaces, providing a robust groundwork for photorealistic spatial content. Our goal is to seamlessly connect professional panoramic capture with specialized 3DGS processing capabilities, making the pipeline from physical space to digital asset more complete and flexible.

We launched Project Eternal alongside Splatica, Aholo, and MipMap to explore how 360 capture can support diverse assetization needs across cultural heritage, digital twins, and immersive content. Rather than enforcing a single, rigid workflow, Project Eternal highlights flexibility, using panoramic capture as a starting point for a wide range of spatial production use cases.

## The Pipeline: Two Layers, One End\-to\-End Path

Through Project Eternal, Insta360 and its partners established a practical collaborative path that connects professional 360 capture with specialized 3DGS processing. With Insta360's standardized INSV file format at the center, panoramic content flows smoothly across downstream platforms, reducing friction between acquisition and generation, shortening production time, and supporting a range of spatial assetization needs.

### Layer 1: Capture — Insta360 X5 \+ Antigravity A1

Insta360 makes spatial capture more efficient, accessible, and practical for 3DGS workflows. With X5 and A1, users can capture rich visual data across varied environments—from confined indoor spaces to expansive outdoor heritage sites—covering more ground with fewer steps, minimal setup complexity, and highly cost\-effective deployment.

This hardware combination supports a streamlined workflow without sacrificing the visual consistency and coverage required for high\-fidelity reconstruction. The INSV file format ensures source material remains consistent and easily transferable across partner platforms, allowing a single capture session to serve multiple downstream workflows.

### Layer 2: Reconstruction — Three Platforms, One Ecosystem

Each partner brings a distinct strength to the pipeline, offering creators tailored options rather than a one\-size\-fits\-all solution:
- **Splatica:*** **Rapid cloud automation for accessible 3DGS.* Splatica offers a streamlined, automated web platform optimized for Insta360 INSV files, delivering ready\-to\-embed 3D scenes and engine\-compatible exports within hours—all without requiring local GPU setups or complex configurations. 
- **Manycore Aholo:*** **Spatial intelligence and high\-fidelity rendering for complex spaces.* Powered by a robust 3DGS algorithm engine, Aholo excels at processing intricate architectural geometries and producing render\-quality outputs that withstand close inspection, making it ideal for world heritage sites and digital twin applications. 
- **MipMap:*** Industrial\-grade precision for complex geometries and offline environments.* Specializing in multi\-source air\-ground fusion modeling \(A1 \+ X5\), MipMap provides professional on\-premise 3DGS and photogrammetry processing for industrial scenarios where cloud processing isn't an option or survey\-grade precision is mandatory.

## Four Standout Reconstructions

Project Eternal successfully captured more than 30 locations worldwide with the help of professional creators and partners. Here are four that best illustrate the range of what's possible.

**Kurotani Konkaikomyoji Temple, Japan** — Japanese creator @takashi.film used Antigravity A1 to capture 8K panoramic footage of this historic Buddhist temple in Kyoto. Splatica processed the INSV footage into [a browser\-navigable spatial experience](https://app.splatica.com/viewer/d0b1fb36), demonstrating how cultural landmarks can be preserved and shared globally without requiring specialized apps or viewing hardware.

**Chengyang Bazhai, Guangxi, China** — A traditional Dong ethnic village known for its drum towers, wind\-and\-rain bridges, and stilted houses. This project combined X5 for ground\-level detail with A1 for aerial coverage. Processed via Aholo, the result transformed the village into a gamified, interactive "digital treasure hunt" where users can explore hidden architectural and cultural elements in a detailed 3D environment.

**Chichén Itzá, Mexico** — As one of the New Seven Wonders of the World, the iconic El Castillo pyramid and its surrounding structures were captured by @Bohdan Bershadskyi using Insta360 One RS. Splatica's automated pipeline quickly produced a clean, explorable 3D model, proving that a high\-quality 3DGS workflow requires neither massive crews nor specialized rigs.

**Borobudur Temple, Indonesia** — With Insta360 X5 and Antigravity A1, creators \(@nabilensart and @arisazumi\) captured the world's largest Buddhist temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. MipMap processed the data, establishing it as one of three major overseas UNESCO cases within Project Eternal \(alongside Pompeii and Civita di Bagnoregio\). The complex, tiered structure, complete with intricate relief panels and stupas, showcases how massive heritage sites can be successfully translated into navigable 3D environments.

## Overcoming the Friction of Traditional 3D Workflows

At the capture layer, Insta360 simplifies data collection through professional 360 hardware and flexible ground\-to\-air acquisition. At the assetization layer, Project Eternal extends this value by bridging capture directly with specialized platforms to make 3D spatial output faster and far more accessible.

The true value of this collaboration lies in how it compresses a traditionally fragmented process. Capture requires less operational complexity and cost, while converting data into usable spatial assets no longer depends on weeks of highly specialized technical labor. Instead of treating panoramic footage as isolated media, Project Eternal establishes it as a practical entry point for cultural preservation, digital twins, and immersive content production.

Ultimately, Project Eternal proved that the combination of **[Insta360 X5](https://store.insta360.com/product/x5?utm_term=INRRF09&i_source=website&i_medium=blog&i_campaign=article18925)** and **[Antigravity A1](https://www.antigravity.tech/us/drone/antigravity-a1/buy?utm_term=INRRF09&i_source=website&i_medium=blog&i_campaign=article18925)** represents the most efficient hardware duo for 3DGS capture today.

## Rethinking Capture and Spatial Production

These initiatives point to a paradigm shift in 3D spatial production. Rather than starting with complex capture requirements and tightly coupled reconstruction pipelines, panoramic imaging serves as a highly flexible and efficient source layer for spatial generation. With lightweight hardware, high capture efficiency, and a standardized media format, Insta360 provides a practical foundation for collecting reconstruction\-ready visual data.

By keeping panoramic source material interoperable across different processing environments, the workflow remains open. The same footage can support various reconstruction methods, output requirements, and deployment goals, giving enterprises greater control over asset production. This combination of efficient capture and downstream flexibility delivers broad value across heritage documentation, digital twins, and immersive media.

## Next Steps

Project Eternal successfully demonstrated a repeatable framework for translating physical spaces into usable, high\-fidelity 3D spatial data across heritage sites and complex environments worldwide.

Moving forward, Insta360 Enterprise will continue to innovate at the intersection of 360 capture and 3DGS workflows. We remain committed to deepening our integration with spatial intelligence technologies and leading the conversation on how physical spaces are transformed for the digital era.

[Project Eternal](https://www.insta360.com/blog/enterprise/project-eternal-3dgs-wrap-up.html) was just the beginning.

# Scan with a 360 camera

This guide explains how to capture high\-quality 360 scans with Scaniverse, from preparing the scene and configuring your camera to capturing, uploading, and processing scans into meshes and Gaussian splats. It also covers supported cameras, recommended capture techniques, and troubleshooting common issues.

Scaniverse supports **360 video files only**, including `.insv` and equirectangular `.mp4`. Still panoramic images \(`.jpg`, `.png`, etc.\) are not supported.

### Workflow[​](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#workflow)

A typical 360 camera workflow includes the following steps:
1. [Choose a supported 360 camera](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#supported-cameras-and-video-formats). 
2. [Configure your camera](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#scene-setup): 
  1. If you're capturing outdoors, set your exposure to **Auto**. 
  2. If you're indoors, set the shutter speed to **1/500** and ISO to **Auto**. 
3. [Capture the scan](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#capture-a-scan) by walking the perimeter, then filling the interior with overlapping passes. 
4. Transfer your video to a desktop computer using an SD card, USB cable, or other supported method. 
5. [Upload your scan](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#upload-scan) to [Scaniverse Web](https://scaniverse.nianticspatial.com/signin). 
6. [Process and download](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#process-and-download) the resulting asset.

## Overview[​](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#overview)

A 360 camera captures the entire environment at once using two lenses that each record slightly more than 180°. The camera stitches these feeds together so you can view the full surroundings in every direction simultaneously as shown in the following video:

A 360 camera is:
- **Efficient:** Capturing an environment with a 360 camera is roughly three times faster than using a mobile phone. 
- **Immersive:** The camera captures the entire environment—floor to ceiling—at once, producing 3D assets that feel complete and immersive. 
- **Easy to use:** The camera sees in all directions simultaneously, which significantly reduces the chance of leaving holes or blind spots in your scan. 
- **Ideal for large areas:** The combination of speed and full\-environment capture makes 360 cameras especially well suited for digitizing large spaces such as marinas, parks, and large indoor facilities. 
- **Limited in duration:** Plus supports up to 5\-minute videos, and Pro supports up to 10\-minute videos for 360 camera uploads. 

### Requirements[​](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#requirements)
- A [supported 360 camera](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#supported-cameras-and-video-formats). 
- A desktop computer for uploading your scan. 
- A Pro or Plus Scaniverse account with available credits. 

### Supported cameras and video formats[​](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#supported-cameras-and-video-formats)

Scaniverse supports 360 video uploads in two formats, depending on your camera.

| Camera type | Upload format | Preparation required |
|---|---|---|
| Insta360 X6, X5, X4 Air, or X4 | Raw `.insv` | Upload directly from the SD card. No stitching or conversion required. |
| Other 360 cameras | Stitched equirectangular `.mp4` | Export the video from the camera manufacturer's desktop software before uploading. |

Commonly used cameras that use the `.mp4` workflow include:
- Insta360 X3 and One RS 1\-inch 360 
- Ricoh Theta X and Theta Z1 
- GoPro Max 2 
- DJI Osmo 360 
- 360 drones such as Antigravity A1 and DJI Avata 360 
tip

Insta360 cameras record both `.INSV` and `.LRV` files. Upload the original `.INSV` files. The `.LRV` files are low\-resolution preview files and are not used for processing.

## Scene setup[​](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#scene-setup)

Prepare the scene before capturing by optimizing lighting, minimizing moving people, and setting up optional metric scale calibration.

### Environment and lighting[​](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#environment-and-lighting)
- Capture in well\-lit, evenly lit environments whenever possible. 
- Avoid strong shadows, direct sunlight, and rapidly changing lighting conditions. 
- Good lighting produces sharper frames and improves reconstruction quality. 

### People in the scene[​](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#people-in-the-scene)

For best results, capture the scene when it is empty.

If people are present:
- People who remain stationary may appear as incomplete or distorted geometry in the final reconstruction. 
- People who are moving are more likely to be removed during processing. 

### Metric scale calibration[​](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#metric-scale-calibration)

To enable real\-world scale:
1. Download the calibration board [US Letter](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/calibration/US%20Letter.pdf) \| [A4](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/calibration/A4.pdf) and print it at 100% scale. 
2. Place the board flat on the floor where you will begin scanning. 
3. Start recording with one 360 camera lens positioned 30–50 cm from the board. 
4. Slowly circle the 360 camera around the board while keeping the board clearly visible and in focus for the first 30 seconds. 
5. Continue scanning the environment as usual. 

The following video demonstrates how to capture the calibration board:

The following image shows how to start recording with the calibration board visible to the camera:
![The metric calibration board should be placed in view of the 360 camera in the beginning of the scan.](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/assets/images/metric_calibration-5d0e332c3555e9e4d2f757d64d1ab03a.jpeg) 

Scaniverse automatically detects the calibration board and applies 1:1 scaling during processing.

## Capture a scan[​](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#capture-a-scan)

This section explains how to capture a scan using a 360 camera. Focus on stable movement, complete coverage, and consistent camera setup.

### Camera and equipment setup[​](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#camera-and-equipment-setup)

Configure your camera before capturing. The following recommended settings are based on the Insta360 X5 but apply broadly to other supported 360 cameras.

**GPS capture**

Capture GPS data whenever your 360 camera supports it so that the scan retains its real\-world location and movement path for geographic alignment and identification. Insta360 cameras do not have built\-in GPS, so a recording started with the 360 camera's shutter button does not include GPS data. To capture GPS data with the Insta360 app:
1. Enable location services on your mobile device and allow the Insta360 app to access your location. 
2. Turn on the Insta360 camera and connect it to the Insta360 app. 
3. Tap the camera icon at the bottom of the Insta360 app to open the live preview. 
4. In the live preview, tap the vertical three\-dot icon \(`⋮`\) in the upper\-right corner of your mobile device's screen and turn on **GPS**. 
5. Start recording from the Insta360 app. 
6. Keep the app open, the mobile device's screen on, and the Insta360 camera connected during the capture. 
7. Stop recording from the Insta360 app. 

For more information, see [Insta360's instructions for recording GPS data with a phone](https://onlinemanual.insta360.com/app/en-us/operation-tutorial/stats-dashboard/dashboard-collection#how-to-add-stats). To capture GPS data with a compatible remote instead, see [Insta360's GPS remote instructions](https://onlinemanual.insta360.com/gpspreviewremote/en-us/camera/basicuse).

**Camera settings**
- Resolution: 8K 
- Frame rate: 30 fps, or 25 fps in PAL \(EU\) regions 
- Adaptive tone: Off 
- Video encoding: H.265 
- Color: Standard 
- Sharpness: Medium 
- Bitrate: High 
- Anti\-flicker: Auto

**Indoor:** Set shutter speed to 1/500 and ISO to Auto. The following video shows how to open exposure settings and set 1/500:

### Plan your capture[​](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#plan-your-capture)

High\-quality captures depend on smooth movement, consistent camera positioning, and complete scene coverage. The following techniques describe how to move through an environment to maximize reconstruction quality while minimizing alignment errors and artifacts:

#### Planning strategies[​](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#planning-strategies)

**Divide large spaces**

Divide large spaces into logical quadrants or sections and scan one section at a time rather than trying to capture the entire area at once. Complete coverage of one section before moving to the next, ensuring adjacent sections overlap. As you move between sections, capture overlapping views that connect both sections to help maintain alignment throughout the reconstruction.

**Cross\-grid open areas \(Optional\)**

For large, open spaces or when the highest reconstruction quality is required, repeat the lattice grid in a perpendicular direction. For example, north\-south followed by east\-west. Cross\-gridding improves coverage and can reduce alignment errors.

**Close the loop**

Toward the end of your scan, briefly point the camera back at a previously scanned landmark to reinforce alignment across the entire reconstruction. Always finish your scan by returning to the same location that you started.

#### Movement[​](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#movement)

**The wave pattern**

Use a gentle sinusoidal wave pattern as you move the camera, rather than keeping it at a constant height. This captures ceilings, upper walls, floors, and furniture in a single pass, improving coverage without requiring additional passes.

**Sinusoidal motion**
- Walk at a slow and steady pace. 
- Slow down when capturing using a sinusoidal wave pattern. 
- In darker areas, slow down to a crawl pace. A 1/500 shutter speed requires more light, and slower movement is the only way to prevent motion blur. 
- Avoid jerks, bouncing, or rapid turns. 

#### Distance[​](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#distance)
- Maintain a minimum distance of 30 cm or 12 inches from all surfaces. 
- Avoid placing the camera into tight spaces or directly beneath furniture, or other overhangs unless you are intentionally capturing additional detail. 
- Avoid placing objects across the stitch line between the two lenses, which can cause warping, blind spots, or artifacts in the final asset. 

#### Coverage[​](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#coverage)

Capture the entire environment with consistent overlap and as few gaps as possible. Adapt your scanning pattern to the geometry of the scene to maintain continuous coverage.
- Overlap adjacent passes. 
- Avoid isolated regions that aren’t connected to the rest of the scan.

## Upload and process scans[​](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#upload-and-process-scans)

After capturing a scan, transfer your files to a desktop computer and upload them to [Scaniverse Web](https://scaniverse.nianticspatial.com/signin) for processing. This section covers how to [prepare your files](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#prepare-files), [upload them](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#upload-scan), and [process and download](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#process-and-download) the resulting assets.

### Prepare files[​](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#prepare-files)

Before uploading, transfer your 360 capture files to a desktop computer. Connect the camera to your computer using a USB\-C cable or remove the microSD card. If connecting the camera directly, select **File Transfer Mode** when prompted so it appears as an external drive. Scaniverse processes 360 data through Scaniverse Web, so all uploads and processing must be done in a desktop browser.
note

360 processing runs exclusively through Scaniverse Web on a desktop browser, not the mobile app.

If you are using an Insta360 X6, X5, X4 Air, or X4, you can upload raw `.insv` files directly without additional preparation. For all other cameras, you must first convert your footage into a stitched `.mp4` file.

**Pre\-processing**

To prepare stitched footage for upload:
1. **Trim:** Remove unnecessary portions of the video to reduce file size and processing time. 
2. **Enable direction lock:** When exporting to `.mp4`, enable direction lock to preserve spatial consistency and gyroscope orientation. 
3. **Export:** Export the stitched file as an `.mp4` using H.264 or H.265 encoding. Insta360 users can optionally use Insta360 Studio to preview raw .INSV recordings before uploading. If using an Insta360 X6, X5, X4 Air, or X4, upload the original .INSV files rather than exporting a stitched .mp4. 

### Upload scan[​](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#upload-scan)

After preparing your file, upload it to Scaniverse Web to begin processing. You can generate a mesh or Gaussian splat from a 360 camera scan.
1. Log in to your [Scaniverse Web account](https://scaniverse.nianticspatial.com/) using a desktop browser. 
2. Upload your scan file: 
  - **Insta360 X6, X5, X4 Air, or X4:** Upload the raw `.insv` file directly from your local drive or SD card. 
  - **Other cameras:** Upload the stitched `.mp4` file exported from your camera’s desktop software. 
3. Start the upload to begin cloud processing. 

Processing begins automatically after the upload completes.

### Process and download[​](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#process-and-download)

After your 360 scan upload finishes, you can generate one or more asset types from that capture. In this step, select the 360 scan, choose whether to generate a splat, a mesh, or both, review the estimated duration and credit cost, and then download the finished asset in the format you need.

**Asset types**
- **Splat:** Best for visual quality and scene preview. Usually takes longer to generate. 
- **Mesh:** Best for geometry\-based 3D workflows and exports. 

After your upload completes, generate assets as follows:
1. Select the Site that contains the scan you want to process. 
2. Select **Generate assets**. 
3. Enter an Asset name. 
4. Under **Choose your scan type**, select **360 scan**. 
5. Select the uploaded 360 scan from the list. A preview and scan details appear on the right. 
6. Under **Choose what assets you want generated**, select one or both of the following: 
  - **Splat** 
  - **Mesh** 
7. Review the **Capture duration** and **Credits required** summary at the bottom of the window. 
8. Select **Generate**. 

During processing, Scaniverse extracts frames from your video and reconstructs the scene. The 360 scan flow generates assets from a single 360 capture. Processing time depends on file size, complexity, and which asset types you selected.

**Video length limits**
- **Free plan**: 360 camera asset generation is not available. 
- **Plus plan**: uploads are limited to videos up to 5 minutes. 
- **Pro plan**: uploads are limited to videos up to 10 minutes. 

Capture each site as a single continuous recording whenever possible. If your recording exceeds your account's supported upload duration, split it into shorter recordings before uploading.

**View assets**

Once processing is complete, you can inspect the generated mesh or splat directly in Scaniverse Web.

**Supported output formats**

Download the generated asset in the following formats:
- **Splat:** `.ply`, `.spz`, `.usdz` 
- **Mesh:** `.glb`, `.usdz` 
---

## Troubleshooting and FAQ[​](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/scaniverse/360camera/#troubleshooting-and-faq)

This section covers common issues and frequently asked questions when capturing and processing 360 scans.

**Blurry splats**
Use a shutter speed of 1/500 for indoor environments to reduce motion blur.

**Drifting or warped environments**
If you used the `.mp4` workflow, verify that direction lock was enabled during export.

**Avoid overscanning** Avoid repeatedly scanning the same area. You can pass through an area twice to connect different parts of a scan, but excessive rescanning can introduce SfM \(structure from motion\) or small alignment errors that reduce the sharpness of the final reconstruction.

**Handling large files**
If your capture exceeds your account tier’s video length limit, trim the footage into smaller segments using your camera’s desktop software before uploading.

**Can I upload a 360 panoramic image \(`.jpg`, `.png`, etc.\)?**
No. Scaniverse supports only 360 **video** files: raw `.insv` files from Insta360 X6, X5, X4 Air, and X4, or stitched equirectangular `.mp4` files from other cameras. Still panoramic images are not supported.

**Can I upload 360 videos via the mobile app?**
No. Uploading and processing 360 video files is only supported via Scaniverse Web on a desktop browser.

**Can I generate a mesh from a 360 camera scan?** Yes. In the **Generate assets** flow, choose **Mesh** instead of **Gaussian splat**.

**Can I export a 360 scan as USDZ?** Yes. Supported 360 splats and meshes can be downloaded as a combined **USDZ** file from Scaniverse Web.

**How can I produce a splat that can be used for 3D measurements?**
Print the calibration board [US Letter](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/calibration/US%20Letter.pdf) \| [A4](https://www.nianticspatial.com/docs/calibration/A4.pdf) and circle it with your camera at the start of your recording. Scaniverse automatically scales the resulting asset to real\-world 1:1 metric measurements.

**Can I use a 360 drone?**
Yes, you can use 360 videos from 360 drones such as the Antigravity A1 and DJI Avata 360.

**Do I need desktop software to process my files?**
- **No, if you have an Insta360 X6, X5, X4 Air, or X4.** Scaniverse Web natively supports raw `.insv` files from these models. No additional software is required. 
- **Yes, if you use any other camera.** Use the manufacturer’s desktop software to stitch your footage into an `.mp4` with direction lock enabled before uploading to Scaniverse Web.

OOOSplat 是一款将普通或全景视频、图片序列一键转换为 3D Gaussian Splatting 的本地桌面应用。选择素材、项目目录和质量档位，即可自动完成生成，并直接预览、编辑和导出结果。

Windows 和 Apple Silicon macOS Alpha 均随应用提供 FFmpeg、FFprobe、COLMAP 和 Brush；Linux 支持目前仅作为 Ubuntu 24.04 LTS x86\_64 Alpha 提供。整个生成流程使用本机 CPU 和 GPU，输入素材、工程文件、模型与日志无需上传到云端重建或训练服务。React 界面通过 Tauri 直接调用本机 Rust 后端，普通生成与预览不需要额外启动 HTTP 服务。

查看 [OOOSplat Roadmap](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat/blob/main/ROADMAP.md) 了解后续规划。

## 核心优势
[Permalink: 核心优势](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat#%E6%A0%B8%E5%BF%83%E4%BC%98%E5%8A%BF)
- **一键生成高斯泼溅**：只需选择输入视频或图片序列、项目目录和质量档位，即可自动完成画面准备、COLMAP 相机重建、Brush 训练和 `final.ply` 发布，无需手动拼接命令或配置引擎。 
- **全平台兼容**：支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，可在三大主流桌面系统上完成本地高斯泼溅生成；具体系统与处理器要求请参阅下方兼容性说明。 
- **安全与隐私保护**：素材、抽帧、相机重建数据、高斯模型和日志默认只保存在用户选择的本地项目目录，核心生成流程在本机完成，无需将原始视频、图像或模型上传到第三方重建与训练平台，从而减少数据在网络传输、云端留存和未经授权访问过程中的泄露风险。 
- **完全本地化算力**：重建与训练均在用户自己的电脑上运行，不调用远程计算服务。满足要求时 COLMAP 自动使用本机 NVIDIA GPU 加速，否则回退 CPU，过程和数据始终由用户掌控。

## 主要功能
[Permalink: 主要功能](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat#%E4%B8%BB%E8%A6%81%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD)
- **一键生成**：支持 MP4、MOV 和 JPG、JPEG、PNG 图片序列，自动完成画面准备、相机重建、训练和 PLY 发布。 
- **全景素材**：支持已拼接、单目、完整 360°×180° 的 2:1 ERP MP4 和图片文件夹；自动检测类型，无法确定时在素材框中选择。 
- **图片顺序确认**：普通及全景图片超过100张时，生成前询问拍摄顺序；已排序使用顺序匹配，未排序或100张及以下使用穷举匹配。 
- **导入外部模型**：可从“已完成”分组导入标准/压缩 PLY、SOG、SPZ、SPLAT 和 KSPLAT；完整 COLMAP 数据会自动关联，并在满足单相机条件时支持增量高清补拍。 
- **三种质量档位**：提供快速、均衡和精细档；自动优化会根据素材与显存选择合适的抽帧、分辨率和训练配置。 
- **透明素材**：支持透明 MOV 和 PNG，保留原始颜色与 Alpha，并自动生成 COLMAP 黑白蒙版。 
- **多任务管理**：任务列表分为新任务、已完成和未完成，可保存多个草稿、调整顺序并自动执行下一个任务；同一时间只运行一个生成任务，支持取消和断点续跑。 
- **补拍**：根据原模型情况选择重建方式及是否沿用原模型，训练参数与正常生成一致；支持跨尺寸普通素材和完整 ERP 全景补拍，派生项目不覆盖原结果。 
- **预览与编辑**：支持 WebGPU／WebGL2、移动轴与旋转环、裁切、删点、反选和撤销重做；可用 WASD 水平漫游或“自动定位视角”返回首帧训练视角。 
- **多种导出**：支持标准 PLY、压缩 PLY、SPZ v4、单文件 SOG，以及竖屏或横屏 MP4、单文件离线 HTML。 
- **本地运行**：COLMAP 重建与 Brush 训练都在本机完成；满足条件时自动使用 GPU，否则使用可用的兼容路径。 
- **跨平台与双语界面**：支持 Windows、Apple Silicon macOS 和 Ubuntu，并可在简体中文与英文之间切换。 

全景图片每批需至少两张且尺寸一致；仅有 2:1 比例不会自动判为全景。不支持双鱼眼、双目、VR180、裁切全景或厂商私有原片；普通与全景投影不能混合补拍。全景缓存不再设固定 20 GiB 上限，请预留足够磁盘空间；单幅解码仍限 512 MiB。格式、参数和验证范围见[全景视频](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat/blob/main/docs/PANORAMA_VIDEO_V1.md)、[全景图片](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat/blob/main/docs/PANORAMA_IMAGES_V1.md)与[补拍说明](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat/blob/main/docs/RESHOOT_V2.md)。

### Gaussian 编辑快捷键
[Permalink: Gaussian 编辑快捷键](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat#gaussian-%E7%BC%96%E8%BE%91%E5%BF%AB%E6%8D%B7%E9%94%AE)
- 矩形选择时，左键拖动替换选区，`Shift \+ 左键拖动`添加，`Ctrl \+ 左键拖动`移除；中键旋转视角，右键平移，滚轮缩放。 
- 黄色高亮表示当前选区；按 `Delete` 或 `Backspace` 删除选中 Gaussian，按 `Esc` 清空临时选区。 
- 在矩形、球形或盒形选择中，点击“反选”或按 `Ctrl \+ I`（macOS 为 `⌘ \+ I`）切换保留或选中的部分。 
- 球形或盒形选择会自动进入正交视图，可切换侧视图、正视图和顶视图，并通过视口控制器或数值面板调整位置与大小。 
- 变换面板中的“场景操作轴”可切换“移动／旋转”，再次点击当前选中的按钮即可关闭；左键拖轴操作模型，拖动空白处转动视角。旋转环和面板旋转都围绕模型中心；松开提交一次编辑，`Esc` 取消本次拖轴，操作轴模式保存在本机。 
- 点击画布或“自动定位视角”后，使用 `WASD` 沿水平面漫游，`Shift` 三倍加速；速度随缩放调整，仅透视视图可用。 
- `Ctrl \+ Z` 撤销，`Ctrl \+ Shift \+ Z` 或 `Ctrl \+ Y` 重做。模型变换、裁切和删除共享同一历史记录；相机移动和临时黄色选区不计入历史。 

## 处理流程
[Permalink: 处理流程](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat#%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B)

```
输入视频或图片序列
  │
  ├─ 视频：FFprobe 分析，FFmpeg 按档位目标 FPS 和工作分辨率抽帧；透明视频同步生成 RGBA 画面与 Mask
  ├─ 图片：快速扫描文件头并按文件名自然排序，复制源素材后优先硬链接复用；按需生成 Alpha Mask
  ├─ COLMAP：自动选择 CPU 或 CUDA GPU 提取特征；视频顺序匹配，图片默认穷举匹配，超过100张可确认按序匹配；顺序匹配在自动优化开启时沿用档位闭环检测规则
  ├─ COLMAP：增量重建并验证注册率和三维点；自动优化开启时可按需尝试桥接补帧
  ├─ 全景：先保留整幅 ERP 做球面重建，仅将已注册画面转为六面训练图片
  ├─ Brush：使用可用 GPU 训练 Gaussian Splats；精细档按显存选择训练配置
  └─ 校验 PLY 后原子发布为 final.ply
```

COLMAP 生成至少一张注册图像和有效三维点后，普通生成任务会继续进入 Brush。注册率低于 80% 时会给出质量警告，不会仅因注册率低而终止；补拍还要求至少一张新增画面成功注册。

图片序列预检只读取 JPG/PNG 文件头，检查数量、尺寸和 Alpha 通道，不提前解码全部像素。“检测到 Alpha 通道”不等于已经找到透明区域，生成时才检查实际透明度并按需启用 Mask。项目仍保留一份源素材副本；项目内的画面优先通过硬链接复用，不支持时回退复制，素材导入和画面准备期间会持续显示进度与日志。

## 系统要求
[Permalink: 系统要求](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat#%E7%B3%BB%E7%BB%9F%E8%A6%81%E6%B1%82)
- Windows 11，x64。 
- 支持 WebView2 Runtime。 
- 视频导出需要 WebView2 提供 WebCodecs AVC 编码能力；不支持时仍可在“动画”模式播放效果，但“导出视频”会显示不可用原因。 
- Brush 训练需要可用的 GPU 图形后端，建议使用独立显卡。 
- COLMAP 的 CUDA 加速需要 NVIDIA 显卡、Windows 驱动 580.00 或更高版本，以及 Compute Capability 7.5 或更高版本；不满足要求时程序会自动使用 CPU，无需用户配置。 
- 项目磁盘需要容纳源素材副本、输入图像、COLMAP 数据、Brush 中间文件和最终 PLY。长视频、大型图片序列或精细档位可能占用大量空间。 
- 安装模式为整机安装，安装时可能需要管理员权限。 

Windows 内置的 COLMAP 使用同时支持 CPU 与 CUDA GPU 的构建，运行前会自动选择可用后端；Brush 训练使用可用图形后端，二者的 GPU 检测与运行机制相互独立。

## 安装与使用
[Permalink: 安装与使用](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat#%E5%AE%89%E8%A3%85%E4%B8%8E%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8)

测试素材：[夸克网盘下载](https://pan.quark.cn/s/1dde892a1324)，可用于测试或体验生成流程。
1. Windows 运行 `OOOSplat\-0.7.0\-x64\-windows.exe`；Apple Silicon Mac 打开 `OOOSplat\-0.7.0\-arm64\-macos.dmg` 并将 OOOSplat 拖入“应用程序”；Ubuntu 24.04 使用 `sudo apt install ./OOOSplat\-0.7.0\-x64\-linux.deb`。 
2. 启动 OOOSplat，确认顶栏中的内置引擎状态正常；可使用右上角的 `EN / 中文` 按钮即时切换界面语言。 
3. 在右侧“任务列表 → 新任务”中选择草稿或点击“新增”，再选择视频文件或图片文件夹。等待类型检测完成；无法确定时，在素材框内选择普通或全景类型。 
4. 选择项目根目录；程序会记住上次使用的位置。 
5. 选择“快速”“均衡”或“精细”档位。 
6. 查看 COLMAP 加速状态并点击“开始生成”；图片超过100张时，需确认文件名是否按拍摄顺序排列，未选择不能启动。 
7. 在左侧查看所选任务的阶段、进度和日志；点击右侧任意任务可切换详情。生成出的项目按状态进入“已完成”或“未完成”，已完成项目可点击“预览”。 
8. 在“预览”的“调整”模式中修改模型，变换、裁切和删除记录会自动保存到项目中，视角按项目保存在本机。点击“保存编辑”可确认当前编辑与视角已保存；需要模型文件时，在“导出”菜单直接选择标准 PLY、压缩 PLY、SPZ 或 SOG，无需再次确认格式。调整和动画模式均可使用。 
9. 切换到“动画”，在命令栏中间选择“竖屏 / 横屏”，通过“导出 → 导出视频”生成 30 FPS、23 秒 MP4，分辨率分别为 1080×1920 和 1920×1080；调整或动画模式均可导出离线 HTML。导出使用当前编辑结果，可取消，完成后可打开所在文件夹。 
10. 如需补充细节，在已完成项目中点击“补拍”，选择新素材并检查类型，按需调整质量和自动优化。点击“开始生成”后回答原模型情况，普通素材还需确认拍摄设置是否相同，无需再次确认方案；开启自动优化也会允许失败后改用更耗时的方案。新旧素材须属于同一场景并有足够重叠。 

使用提示：
- 拖动左右面板之间的分界线可以调整宽度；双击分界线恢复默认比例。 
- 点击右下角百分比按钮可缩小、恢复或放大整个界面。 
- 新任务草稿会在本机保存，重启后重新检查素材。运行中的任务参数不能修改，但可以切换并编辑其他草稿；不能同时启动第二个任务。 
- 新任务可拖动排序。“自动执行下一个任务”默认关闭，开启后按顺序执行，不跳过未就绪任务；图片顺序确认会暂停启动，取消则关闭队列。 
- 新补拍默认继承源项目质量和自动优化，启动前可修改。普通补拍支持不同尺寸、宽高比和设备／镜头；全景仅接收完整 ERP，批次之间可不同尺寸。不能重复输入原素材，缺少可信图片或重建数据时不能启动。 
- 沿用原模型时，从未经编辑的生成 PLY 初始化，旧图、新图共同使用正常完整训练配方，不另行缩短步数或降低学习率。只有确认拍摄设置相同且单相机、工作图片尺寸及方向兼容时才复用原内参。它不是完整断点续训，也不保证只改变新增区域；派生项目不继承删除或裁切。已有任务仍按原快照执行。实测范围见[补拍说明](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat/blob/main/docs/RESHOOT_V2.md)。 
- 任务页日志保留最近 500 条，完整引擎日志位于项目的 `logs/` 目录。训练资源面板默认隐藏，可在“设置 → 界面”中开启。 
- 点击“删除”会回收整个项目目录，包括源视频副本和所有中间文件；如果移入回收站失败，程序不会降级为永久删除。 

## 质量档位
[Permalink: 质量档位](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat#%E8%B4%A8%E9%87%8F%E6%A1%A3%E4%BD%8D)

“自动优化（实验性）”默认开启。普通视频会在抽帧时一次性缩放到对应工作分辨率，并保持原始宽高比且不会放大低分辨率素材；实际采样不会超过源视频 FPS 或总帧数。普通图片序列保留全部有效图片和原始输入分辨率，但 COLMAP 与 Brush 仍使用对应档位的处理上限。

自动优化开启/关闭时各档位的完整参数、Bridge/Caspar/OOM 处理逻辑，以及开发环境外部配置覆盖方法见[自动优化参数配置](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat/blob/main/docs/pipeline-optimization-config.zh-CN.md)。默认参数集中维护在 `config/pipeline\-optimization.json`。

自动优化开启时，视频及已确认按序排列的图片使用档位对应的离线闭环检测；关闭时不启用。闭环检测可能增加匹配时间，不保证所有素材均能闭环；新补拍独立匹配新旧画面，新增画面之间沿用窗口10和档位闭环规则，Bridge 策略不变。

下表为普通素材配置。全景使用独立配方：关闭自动优化时，快速／均衡／精细的 Splat 上限为100万／200万／300万；开启时按档位与显存确定，最高1,000万，上限不保证实际点数或显存安全。详见[全景训练参数与实测](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat/blob/main/docs/PANORAMA_IMAGES_V1.md#%E5%85%A8%E6%99%AF%E8%AE%AD%E7%BB%83%E9%85%8D%E6%96%B9-v1)。

| 档位 |  视频初始 / 桥接目标 |  视频工作长边 |  COLMAP 长边 / 最大特征数 |  Brush 训练 | 
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 快速 |  6 / 9 FPS |  最大 1,600 |  1,200 / 4,096 |  8,000 iterations，最大分辨率 1,600 | 
| 均衡 |  8 / 12 FPS |  最大 1,920 |  1,600 / 8,192 |  15,000 iterations，最大分辨率 1,920 | 
| 精细 |  12 / 15 FPS |  依据显存为最大 3,200、3,840 或原生分辨率 |  3,200 / 16,384 |  30,000 iterations，依据显存选择最大分辨率和 Splat 上限 | 

短视频会尽量保留至少 30 张画面；源帧不足时使用全部可用画面。因此实际初始和候选采样率可能高于表中的目标值，但不会超过源帧率或源素材帧数。

精细档的初始配置按可用显存划分：显存低于 8 GB 或无法读取时，视频和 Brush 最大长边为 3,200；8 GB（含）至 12 GB 之间为 3,840；12 GB（含）以上保留视频原生长边，并让 Brush 使用原生长边。三个精细配置的 COLMAP 图像长边均限制为 3,200。桥接补帧仅在视频初始重建覆盖不足且仍有候选画面时尝试；失败会安全回退到初始重建，不适用于图片序列。精细档在明确检测到显存不足时最多自动降低一次训练配置并重试。

普通素材关闭自动优化后，快速、均衡、精细档分别恢复为保留源视频 30%、50%、100% 画面的旧版策略；视频画面长边沿用旧版最大 1,920，Brush 最大训练分辨率分别为 1,200、1,600、2,000，且不额外设置 Splat 数量上限。

## 匿名使用统计
[Permalink: 匿名使用统计](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat#%E5%8C%BF%E5%90%8D%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8%E7%BB%9F%E8%AE%A1)

OOOSplat 默认开启匿名使用统计，用于了解稳定性和各阶段耗时。可在右上角 **设置 → 隐私** 中随时关闭，关闭后不再发送匿名统计请求。

会发送的内容：

| 字段 |  说明 | 
|---|---|
| 安装 ID |  首次启动生成的随机 UUID，不读取硬件序列号、MAC 地址或设备指纹 | 
| 应用版本、操作系统、CPU 架构 |  例如 `0.7.0` / `windows` / `x86\_64` | 
| 事件名 |  `daily\_active`、`generation\_started`、`generation\_completed`、`generation\_failed`、`pipeline\_stage\_completed`、`planner\_evaluation`。`daily\_active` 每天最多一次，应用升级后当天会再报一次 | 
| 质量档位与输入类型 |  枚举值，例如 `balanced` / `video`；图片序列输入报 `images` | 
| 阶段耗时与总耗时 |  毫秒 | 
| 基础生成事件的帧数与视频时长 |  分桶值；Planner 效果事件另含实际素材和重建数量 | 
| 自动优化效果指标 |  匿名的素材尺寸与数量、规划结果、注册图像与三维点数、桥接补帧、Brush 配置、Splat 数量、PLY 大小和阶段耗时；普通生成、续跑及补拍均记录，关闭自动优化时仍可用于效果比较 | 
| Planner 显卡信息 |  厂商枚举和检测到的总显存，不含完整显卡名称或设备序列号；无法检测时留空或标记为未知 | 
| 失败阶段与错误码 |  枚举值，例如 `colmap\_mapper\_failed`；不含原始错误文本 | 

匿名统计不会发送的内容：视频、图片、PLY 等任何素材；文件名、路径和项目名称；日志与命令输出；用户名或任何个人信息。

### 主动发送错误报告
[Permalink: 主动发送错误报告](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat#%E4%B8%BB%E5%8A%A8%E5%8F%91%E9%80%81%E9%94%99%E8%AF%AF%E6%8A%A5%E5%91%8A)

生成失败后，可在报错弹窗点击“发送错误报告”，先查看脱敏后的完整内容，再选择“同意并发送”。报告包含错误原因、详细错误、失败时最近最多 200 行／64 KiB 日志、应用版本、系统版本和全部可检测的显卡信息；不包含素材、模型、设备序列号或匿名安装标识，路径、文件名和用户名等会移除。读取失败的信息会留空，不会猜测实际使用的显卡。

这是独立的一次性授权：即使关闭匿名统计，也可以主动发送，不会开启统计。取消预览不上传；发送失败仅允许手动重试，成功后显示报告编号。本地报告及预览在本次应用运行期间有效，没有查看时限，关闭应用后清除；云端收到的报告保留 30 天。接收服务尚未部署或网络不可用时，会明确提示发送失败，不会假报成功。服务端部署说明见 [错误报告接入说明](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat/blob/main/server/diagnostics/README.md)。

```
cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri\Cargo.toml --bin splatstudio -- probe "D:\Videos\orbit.mp4"

# 查看抽帧计划但不写出画面
cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri\Cargo.toml --bin splatstudio -- plan "D:\Videos\orbit.mp4" --quality balanced

# 单独抽帧
cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri\Cargo.toml --bin splatstudio -- extract "D:\Videos\orbit.mp4" "D:\Frames" --quality fast

# 运行完整流水线（自动检测并选择 COLMAP GPU 或 CPU）
cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri\Cargo.toml --bin splatstudio -- generate "D:\Videos\orbit.mp4" --projects-root "D:\Splat Projects" --quality balanced

# 图片序列使用同一命令，传入文件夹即可
cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri\Cargo.toml --bin splatstudio -- generate "D:\Photos\object" --projects-root "D:\Splat Projects" --quality balanced
```

开发或诊断时可以通过全局参数 `\-\-engine\-dir <路径>`，或环境变量 `OOOSPLAT\_ENGINE\_DIR`，覆盖默认引擎目录。

Linux 的 FFmpeg/FFprobe 保留各自的环境变量与 PATH 发现方式；Brush 默认只使用托管目录 `linux/brush/brush\_app`，显式 `OOOSPLAT\_BRUSH` 诊断覆盖也必须支持新 CLI，不再自动回退 PATH。COLMAP 只使用托管目录 `linux/colmap/bin/colmap`，不接受单独的 `OOOSPLAT\_COLMAP` 或 PATH 回退。

## 常见问题

### 如何让 COLMAP 使用显卡？
[Permalink: 如何让 COLMAP 使用显卡？](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat#%E5%A6%82%E4%BD%95%E8%AE%A9-colmap-%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8%E6%98%BE%E5%8D%A1)

无需手动选择。Windows 和 Ubuntu 会检查锁定的 COLMAP CUDA 运行时、NVIDIA 驱动版本和显卡 Compute Capability，满足要求时自动使用 GPU 加速特征提取与匹配。CUDA 13.2.0 的最低兼容要求为 NVIDIA 驱动 580.00、Compute Capability 7.5；Caspar 另需实际 BA 探测通过，失败仅回退 Ceres，不影响可用的 SIFT GPU。检测结果显示在任务配置中，当前任务实际使用的后端以该任务的信息和日志为准；后台检测短暂超时不会把正在运行的任务切换为 CPU。macOS 的 COLMAP 使用 CPU，Brush 独立选择可用图形后端。

### 不同显卡组合会如何处理？
[Permalink: 不同显卡组合会如何处理？](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat#%E4%B8%8D%E5%90%8C%E6%98%BE%E5%8D%A1%E7%BB%84%E5%90%88%E4%BC%9A%E5%A6%82%E4%BD%95%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86)

COLMAP 和 Brush 是两个独立阶段：COLMAP 只有兼容的 NVIDIA CUDA 环境才能使用 GPU；Brush 在 Windows 和 Linux 上使用 Vulkan，在 Apple Silicon macOS 上使用 Metal。常见组合按以下方式处理；表中未另行标注平台的组合均指 Windows：

| 平台与显卡组合 |  COLMAP |  Brush 训练 |  自动优化的精细档显存配置 | 
|---|---|---|---|
| Windows：单张 NVIDIA 独显 |  满足驱动和 Compute Capability 要求时使用 CUDA |  明确选择第一张独立 GPU，通过 Vulkan 运行 |  使用该 NVIDIA 显卡的总显存选择 Low、Standard 或 Large | 
| Intel 核显 \+ 单张 NVIDIA 独显 |  使用符合要求的 NVIDIA CUDA |  明确选择第一张独立 GPU，避免误用 Intel 核显 |  使用 NVIDIA 总显存分档 | 
| AMD 核显 \+ 单张 NVIDIA 独显 |  使用符合要求的 NVIDIA CUDA |  明确选择第一张独立 GPU，并仅为 Brush 子进程规避 AMD Switchable Graphics 隐式层 |  使用 NVIDIA 总显存分档 | 
| 仅 AMD，或 Intel 核显 \+ AMD 独显 |  自动回退 CPU |  由 Vulkan 自动选择 AMD GPU；不会禁用 AMD 图形层 |  当前使用保守的 Low 配置 | 
| 仅 Intel 核显或 Intel 独显 |  自动回退 CPU |  由 Vulkan 自动选择 Intel GPU |  当前使用保守的 Low 配置 | 
| 多张 NVIDIA 显卡 |  选择 Compute Capability 最高的兼容显卡；相同时选择 NVIDIA 索引较小者 |  因 Vulkan 与 CUDA 的设备索引不能可靠对应，不强制 Brush 的设备索引，由 Vulkan 自动选择 |  使用 COLMAP 选中显卡的总显存分档 | 
| AMD 独显 \+ NVIDIA 独显 |  COLMAP 使用符合要求的 NVIDIA |  当前会进入单 NVIDIA 优先策略，但跨品牌独显的 Vulkan 排序无法完全保证；建议同时在 Windows 图形设置中把 `brush\_app.exe` 设为“高性能”并检查任务日志中的实际适配器 |  使用 NVIDIA 总显存分档 | 
| NVIDIA 驱动过旧、型号不兼容或检测失败 |  自动回退 CPU |  Brush 仍会尝试通过 Vulkan 自动选择可用 GPU，但不会强制 NVIDIA |  当前使用保守的 Low 配置 | 
| 没有可用 GPU 图形后端 |  COLMAP 使用 CPU |  Brush 可能无法启动；CPU\-only 软件图形后端尚未完成端到端验证 |  不适用 | 
| macOS：Apple Silicon M 系列（含 Pro、Max、Ultra） |  当前使用 CPU，不启用 CUDA |  自动使用 M 系列芯片的 Metal GPU 和统一内存 |  当前不会按统一内存容量提升显存档，使用保守的 Low 配置 | 
| Ubuntu Alpha：兼容的 NVIDIA GPU |  满足运行时、驱动和 Compute Capability 要求时使用 CUDA，否则回退 CPU |  通过 Vulkan 自动选择可用 GPU，不强制 Windows 选卡策略 |  根据兼容 NVIDIA 显卡的总显存选择 Low、Standard 或 Large | 
| Ubuntu Alpha：AMD、Intel 或无法检测兼容 NVIDIA GPU |  使用 CPU |  通过 Vulkan 自动选择可用 GPU |  使用保守的 Low 配置 | 

上述强制选卡和 AMD 隐式层规避只通过环境变量传给单次 `brush\_app.exe` 子进程，不会修改系统环境、驱动设置或其他应用，也不会将 Brush 切换到 D3D12。AMD\-only 设备不会应用 AMD 隐式层规避。

如果 Brush 日志显示 `Device Lost`，OOOSplat 会将其与显存不足区分并给出提示，但不会自动降低质量重试。建议接通电源、关闭其他 GPU 高负载程序，并在 Windows“设置 → 系统 → 显示 → 图形”中将 `brush\_app.exe` 设为“高性能”。精细档只有在明确识别为显存不足时才会降低一级配置，并且最多重试一次。

M 系列芯片的 CPU 与 GPU 共享统一内存，但当前 Planner 不会把统一内存等同于独立显存。因此，即使是内存较大的 M 系列 Pro、Max 或 Ultra，精细档目前仍采用 Low 配置；这属于保守兼容策略，不代表 Metal 训练只能使用少量统一内存。

### 为什么会出现注册率较低的警告？
[Permalink: 为什么会出现注册率较低的警告？](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat#%E4%B8%BA%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E4%BC%9A%E5%87%BA%E7%8E%B0%E6%B3%A8%E5%86%8C%E7%8E%87%E8%BE%83%E4%BD%8E%E7%9A%84%E8%AD%A6%E5%91%8A)

注册率较低通常表示可用于重建的连续视角不足。任务仍会继续进入 Brush，但结果质量可能受影响。建议使用曝光稳定、画面清晰、运动连续、视角重叠充分的环绕拍摄视频，避免快速转动、强反光、大面积纯色和运动物体。

### 为什么项目占用空间很大？
[Permalink: 为什么项目占用空间很大？](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat#%E4%B8%BA%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E9%A1%B9%E7%9B%AE%E5%8D%A0%E7%94%A8%E7%A9%BA%E9%97%B4%E5%BE%88%E5%A4%A7)

每个项目会保留源素材副本、输入画面、COLMAP 数据和 Brush 中间文件，便于诊断和续跑。图片序列在项目内部优先使用硬链接，减少重复物理复制；确认结果后，可通过任务列表中的“删除”将整个项目移入回收站。

### 可以直接在应用中查看 final.ply 吗？
[Permalink: 可以直接在应用中查看 final.ply 吗？](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat#%E5%8F%AF%E4%BB%A5%E7%9B%B4%E6%8E%A5%E5%9C%A8%E5%BA%94%E7%94%A8%E4%B8%AD%E6%9F%A5%E7%9C%8B-finalply-%E5%90%97)

可以。在任务列表中选择已完成项目并点击“预览”，即可在独立预览工作区浏览 `.ply`。“调整”模式支持整体 Transform，以及矩形、球形和盒形 Gaussian 选择；可以非破坏式删除、裁切、反选、撤销和重做。编辑记录会自动保存在项目中；“保存编辑”确认当前编辑与视角已保存，不生成模型文件。在“导出”菜单直接选择模型格式即可生成或安全替换编辑结果，原始 `final.ply` 始终不变。重新打开时恢复编辑与本机保存的视角，黄色选区和撤销历史不跨次恢复。“动画”模式提供 5 秒显现、8 秒冲击波、持续环绕，以及带水印的横竖屏 MP4 和离线 HTML 导出。外部标准/压缩 PLY、SOG、SPZ、SPLAT 和 KSPLAT 可从“已完成 → 导入”导入；不支持 LCC/LCC2、Streamed SOG、2DGS 或普通点云 PLY。

`WASD` 沿水平面漫游，速度为每秒当前可见画面高度的15%，`Shift` 三倍加速。“自动定位视角”从任意视图返回首帧训练相机，全景使用最早已注册画面的 front 面；无可靠训练相机时禁用。打开预览仍优先恢复上次视角，详见[导航说明](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat/blob/main/docs/PREVIEW_NAVIGATION.md)。

### 超大 PLY 可以预览吗？
[Permalink: 超大 PLY 可以预览吗？](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat#%E8%B6%85%E5%A4%A7-ply-%E5%8F%AF%E4%BB%A5%E9%A2%84%E8%A7%88%E5%90%97)

大于 256 MiB 的 PLY 使用 Range 分块读取，每次约 1 MB，减少文件传输阶段的整文件缓冲；不会压缩、降采样或丢弃 SH 数据。解析、排序和 GPU 纹理仍需要内存与显存，能否打开取决于模型大小和设备能力，不保证所有大模型都能加载。

### 模型可以导出哪些格式？
[Permalink: 模型可以导出哪些格式？](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat#%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E5%8F%AF%E4%BB%A5%E5%AF%BC%E5%87%BA%E5%93%AA%E4%BA%9B%E6%A0%BC%E5%BC%8F)

预览的“导出”菜单支持模型、竖屏/横屏视频和单文件离线 HTML。模型导出格式如下：

| 格式 |  用途与体积 | 
|---|---|
| 标准 PLY |  完整精度，通常最大，适合保存和继续编辑 | 
| 压缩 PLY |  文件较小，有损压缩，需查看器支持 | 
| SPZ v4 |  文件很小，有损压缩，适合分享 | 
| 单文件 SOG |  通常压缩率更高，有损压缩，适合网页展示 | 

SOG、SPZ 通常更小，实际体积取决于模型，压缩可能影响细节。点击格式后才开始处理，不生成中转 PLY；原始 `final.ply` 不变，失败或取消保留已有导出。不再按估算内存门槛禁止压缩，但大模型仍可能因实际内存不足而失败。SPZ 坐标越界时会询问是否仅对导出副本居中、必要时等比缩小；位置、尺寸和单位可能改变，无法安全编码时仍会停止。详见[导出说明与验证记录](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat/blob/main/docs/model-export-verification.md)。

离线 HTML 保留编辑结果，支持浏览和播放动画，不提供编辑功能；大模型仍受设备内存与显存限制。
